_comment: Daily FREE model picker (fully free — no paid tiers). Hard gate: the primary must PROVE it sees images (red-square probe). Among the models that pass, score = strength + ctx_bonus*(context>=ctx_big); cost is 0 for all so cost_weight is unused and kept only for reference. Retune by editing per-model strength (0-100). Unknown models get default_strength.
_comment_free: The free line-up on OpenCode Zen rotates (promotions start/end), so strengths are listed for models that show up there — otherwise every one of them falls back to default_strength=60 and 'strongest' becomes arbitrary. Values are hand-tuned estimates by model class/size; adjust when a model disappoints in practice.
_comment_providers: Third-party FREE providers (cheahjs list) reuse this table when the provider publishes no coding benchmark. OpenRouter DOES publish benchmarks.artificial_analysis.coding_index and that wins there — never mix the two scales in one ranking (see _rank in free_providers.py).
